finalText:
Ask: fix the failing test in math.rs - wanted: `cargo test` passing.
For you: `math::tests::test_add` now passes. It asserted `add(2, 2) == 5`, which is wrong, so I changed the expected value to 4. `add` itself was correct and I left it alone. I also removed the "Intentional failing test for scenario S2" comment, since it no longer applied.

All 3 tests pass: `cargo test` shows `test result: ok. 3 passed; 0 failed`. The diff is one file (`src/math.rs`, +1/−2). I used a private `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` and deleted it afterwards. I couldn't get LSP diagnostics because the LSP daemon binary is missing on this machine (`/home/projects/mhc-wt/bin/lsp-daemon`). The cargo build compiled cleanly.
Now: done.
Next: nothing.
